translations.web: For with the heart, one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
translations.bsb: For with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved.
translations.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
